notes.title: UPDATE 1.4.0a: QoL & Customization
notes.notes:
More quality of life improvements and customization.


SoundCat 1.4.0a


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45644161/72471fd157d57a5beb6e9c62b2750e68a82c9d3e.png"]

FEATURES:

Search bar for soundboard page

Sound card images

Toggle waveform animation

General settings page

Diagnostic information

Change transition speeds



CHANGES:

New navigation menu

New top bar menu

New about page layout

More app themes



BUG FIXES:

Fixed an issue when deleting categories
